media:group.media:title: Miu Miu Holiday 2026 Campaign
media:group.media:description:
A tableau unfolds in a grand townhouse, immaculately bedecked for the festive season. Captured by Emilie Blichfeldt, the Miu Miu Holiday 2026 campaign centers around Crystal Fish, Gigi Hadid, Louisa Jacobson, XiaoWen Ju, Georgia Martin, Momo and Nyla Singleton immersed in a seasonal dream.
Moving seamlessly between the real and the unreal, the earthly and the imagined, the campaign presents a festive and immaculately composed portrait of bourgeois behavior subverted by humor and play.
Creative Director: Miuccia Prada Art direction: Christopher Simmonds Photographer: Tina Barney Director: Emilie Blichfeldt Styling: Lotta Volkova Cast: Crystal Fish, Gigi Hadid, Louisa Jacobson, XiaoWen Ju, Georgia Martin, Momo, Nyla Singleton
#MiuMiu #MiuMiuHoliday
American Humane Society monitored the animal action. No animals were harmed® (AH 14494)

entry.title: Miu Miu Women’s Tales #32 | Behind the Scenes with Amelia Dimoldenberg

media:group.media:title: Miu Miu Women’s Tales #32 | Behind the Scenes with Amelia Dimoldenberg
media:group.media:description:
Follow @AmeliaDimoldenberg through Venice for Miu Miu Women’s Tales #32 and the premiere of Avec Kim, directed by Claire Denis. From her hotel room to the screening and dinner, Amelia moves between backstage glimpses, encounters and the events surrounding the 32nd commission of Miu Miu Women’s Tales. Along the way, she meets Suzanne Lindon, lead of Avec Kim, as Venice becomes the setting for a playful look behind the film.
Discover Avec Kim, starring Suzanne Lindon and Kim Gordon, with a score by Gordon. Featuring Amelia Dimoldenberg, Claire Denis and Suzanne Lindon.
#MiuMiu #MiuMiuWomensTales

entry.title: Miu Miu Women’s Tales #32 | Interview with Suzanne Lindon

media:group.media:title: Miu Miu Women’s Tales #32 | Interview with Suzanne Lindon
media:group.media:description:
In Miu Miu Women’s Tales #32, Avec Kim, Suzanne Lindon enters Claire Denis’ cinema through the freedom Denis gives her actors to adapt and improvise. Lindon plays a young mechanic whose day changes after a restored 1980s sedan leaves the garage and Paris opens before her. In this interview, she reflects on the character, Denis’ way of working and a film that leads toward Kim, played by Kim Gordon.
Discover more about “Avec Kim” as the 32nd commission of Miu Miu Women’s Tales.
#MiuMiu #MiuMiuWomensTales
